text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate on route /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). Suspected incorrect fallback to incompatible variant.

jordan (oncall): I'm on it. Observed 502/500 spikes starting 20:12 UTC, 2m rolling window.

alana (sre): seeing logs that show 'variant: chat-instruct-v2' receiving traffic for embeddings route. looks like anchoring mismatch.

devin (runtime): Confirmed. Routing policy currently resolves alias "embeddings-prod" -> anchor `v2`. `v2` is a chat/instruct variant. Fallback is hitting the chat runtime which throws schema errors for embed requests.

maria (cs): any estimate on affected customers? which tenants?

jordan (oncall): quick check: three high-QPS tenants (acct-A, acct-B, acct-C) show 40-60% error rates. Support ticket INC-11021 opened and owners pinged.

samir (infra): I can apply a temp override to force the correct embeddings variant. Recommend: route embeddings-prod -> embeddings-v1 explicitly while we investigate.

devin (runtime): Agreed. Override command ready: 

```bash
# emergency override: force correct variant for embeddings alias
routectl override set --alias embeddings-prod --variant embeddings-v1 --reason "emergency: anchor v2 is chat-instruct"
```

ops-runner: deploying override now.

ops-runner: `deploy:override/embeddings-prod` started

incident-bot: PagerDuty: oncall-jordan acknowledged

jordan (oncall): override applied. watching metrics.

alana (sre): errors dropped almost immediately for the affected tenants from ~48% to ~3%. :thumbsup:

maria (cs): I'll draft a customer advisory and notify account managers. Do we want to offer credits?

devin (runtime): Root cause summary: the promotion script for anchors promoted `v2` as global anchor. The promotion didn't enforce modality scoping (chat vs embeddings). The policy engine treats anchors as a fallback target for any alias unless the alias specifies a modality.

samir (infra): I'm rolling back the global anchor and adding a modality guard to the promotion config. Proposed config change below.

```yaml
# routing-policies.yaml (patched)
- alias: embeddings-prod
  anchor: v2
  modality: embeddings  # ensure anchor only applies for embeddings routes
```

samir (infra): I'll gate the rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) after tests.

jordan (oncall): action items: 1) revoke broad promotion rights from the anchor script 2) add modality validation to the promotion pipeline 3) run a sweep to detect any other aliases pointing to chat variants for non-chat routes.

maria (cs): customer impact: 3 tenants affected, outage window ~12 minutes (20:12–20:24 UTC). CS will offer credits and send the incident advisory using template.

devin (runtime): Opening an RFC for variant-scoped anchors and adding an e2e test to ensure route+variant modality compatibility. Also recommend traffic fuzz tests to catch this earlier.

alana (sre): I'll start the postmortem draft and timeline. tagging @devsec for an audit of the promotion tool.

ops-runner: `deploy:override/embeddings-prod` finished successfully.

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 -> downgraded to Sev3 (user impact mitigated) at 20:25 UTC.

jordan (oncall): handing off to next oncall (lee) at 20:30 UTC. leaving full notes in the postmortem doc.

jordan (oncall): notes: saved request traces, config diff, restore command.

maria (cs): thanks team, syncing with billing & AMs. :heart:

devin (runtime): suggestion: retain traffic dump for 48h; capture a sample of failed requests and the variant resolution logs.

alana (sre): dump uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2475009999.tar.gz

samir (infra): follow-up: add a lint rule to block anchor promotions without a modality tag, and add an automated scanner for existing anchors.

jordan (oncall): thank you everyone. closing thread. will link the postmortem and RFC in #incidents as follow-ups.
